items.source: Delegates to hasError(HttpStatusCode) with the response status code.
items.translation: 委托给带有响应状态代码的hasError(HttpStatusCode)。

items.source: response - the response to inspect
items.translation: response - 要检查的响应

items.source: This error handler checks for the status code on the ClientHttpResponse. Any code in the 4xx or 5xx series is considered to be an error. This behavior can be changed by overriding hasError(HttpStatusCode). Unknown status codes will be ignored by hasError(ClientHttpResponse).
items.translation: 此错误处理器会检查 ClientHttpResponse 上的状态码。任何 4xx 或 5xx 系列的状态码均被视为错误。您可以通过重写 hasError(HttpStatusCode) 来更改此行为。hasError(ClientHttpResponse) 将忽略未知的状态码。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to HttpClientErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset) for errors in the 4xx range, to HttpServerErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset) for errors in the 5xx range, or otherwise raises UnknownHttpStatusCodeException.
items.translation: 默认实现会针对 4xx 范围的错误委托给HttpClientErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset)，针对 5xx 范围的错误委托给HttpServerErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset)，否则抛出UnknownHttpStatusCodeException。

items.source: See handleError(URI, HttpMethod, ClientHttpResponse) for more details on specific exception types.
items.translation: 有关特定异常类型的详细信息，请参阅handleError(URI, HttpMethod, ClientHttpResponse)。

items.source: The default implementation checks HttpStatusCode.isError(). Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现检查HttpStatusCode.isError()。可在子类中重写。

items.source: The default implementation throws:
items.translation: 默认实现抛出：

items.source: Template method called from hasError(ClientHttpResponse).
items.translation: 由hasError(ClientHttpResponse)调用的模板方法。

items.source: Return a function for decoding the error content. This can be passed to RestClientResponseException.setBodyConvertFunction(Function).
items.translation: 返回一个用于解码错误内容的函数。该函数可以传递给 RestClientResponseException.setBodyConvertFunction(Function)。

items.source: Determine the charset of the response (for inclusion in a status exception).
items.translation: 确定响应的字符集（用于包含在状态异常中）。

items.source: Read the body of the given response (for inclusion in a status exception).
items.translation: 读取响应正文（用于包含在状态异常中）。

items.source: HttpClientErrorException if the status code is in the 4xx series, or one of its sub-classes such as HttpClientErrorException.BadRequest and others.
items.translation: 如果状态码属于 4xx 系列，则抛出 HttpClientErrorException，或其子类之一（如 HttpClientErrorException.BadRequest 等）。

items.source: HttpServerErrorException if the status code is in the 5xx series, or one of its sub-classes such as HttpServerErrorException.InternalServerError and others.
items.translation: 如果状态码为 5xx 系列，或其子类（如 HttpServerErrorException.InternalServerError）之一时，则抛出HttpServerErrorException。

items.source: UnknownHttpStatusCodeException for error status codes not in the HttpStatus enum range.
items.translation: UnknownHttpStatusCodeException 用于不在 HttpStatus 枚举范围内的错误状态码。

items.source: hasError in interface ResponseErrorHandler
items.translation: `hasError` 在接口 `ResponseErrorHandler` 中

items.source: handleError in interface ResponseErrorHandler
items.translation: `handleError` 接口 `ResponseErrorHandler` 中

items.source: true if the response indicates an error; false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示响应指示错误；否则为 false。

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O errors
items.translation: `IOException` - 在发生 I/O 错误时

items.source: UnknownHttpStatusCodeException - in case of an unresolvable status code
items.translation: UnknownHttpStatusCodeException - 在无法解析的状态码的情况下

items.source: statusCode - the HTTP status code
items.translation: statusCode - HTTP 状态码

items.source: url - the request URL
items.translation: url - 请求 URL

items.source: response - the response with the error
items.translation: response - 包含错误的响应

items.source: the associated charset, or null if none
items.translation: 关联的字符集，或者如果没有则为null。

items.source:
the response body as a byte array,
or an empty byte array if the body could not be read
items.translation: 作为字节数组返回响应正文，如果无法读取正文则返回空字节数组。

items.source:
Handle the error in the given response with the given resolved status code
and extra information providing access to the request URL and HTTP method.
items.translation: 处理给定响应中的错误，并使用给定的已解决状态码以及提供请求 URL 和 HTTP 方法的额外信息。

items.source: Handle the error based on the resolved status code.
items.translation: 根据解析后的状态码处理错误。

items.source: Return a function for decoding the error content.
items.translation: 返回一个用于解码错误内容的函数。

items.source: method - the HTTP method
items.translation: method - HTTP 方法
